name: Mordekaiser
notes: Casts go one at a time: each of Realm of Death, Obliterate and Death's Grasp has a real cast time (0.5 s, 0.5 s, 0.25 s per the dossier) that keeps Mordekaiser busy — no other cast and no attack starts inside it. A single busy_until tracks this.

Opens with Realm of Death (R) at t = 0: its cast (0.5 s) ends with its true damage (10% of the dummy's maximum health) landing and the target's 10% armor/magic resistance reduction applying (modeled with the engine's shred slot, declared under Q as the engine requires); the rest of R's stat theft (AP/attack speed/health gained by Mordekaiser, the target's base AD reduced) is not modeled since it does not translate into measurable extra damage against a stationary dummy with unspecified own AP/attack speed.
R's true damage ignores mitigation and does not trigger on-ability-damage item effects (Muramana, Eclipse), per the wiki's damage flags (dApplyDamageModifier = false).

Obliterate (Q) and Death's Grasp (E) are then cast on cooldown for the rest of the fight, each waiting for any cast already in progress; Q's isolated-hit multiplier is always applied because the dummy is the only enemy present.
Q's flat level-based bonus damage (0 through level 9, +5 per level from 10 to 18) is included per the wiki's reconstructed formula for MordekaiserQ#QDamage.

Death's Grasp's claw damage lands 0.5 s after its cast starts (the dossier's stated delay), which is after its own 0.25 s cast time completes; the cast time itself keeps Mordekaiser busy and holds attacks, while the extra time to the claw's damage is modeled as its own event. Death's Grasp's passive magic penetration (5-15%) is not modeled: the engine exposes no caster-penetration path to the driver.

Darkness Rise (Passive) gains a stack (capped at 3, refreshing a 4 s window) from basic attacks, Obliterate and Death's Grasp; at 3 stacks it deals its magic-damage aura to the dummy every 1 second until the stack window lapses without a refresh. The dummy is treated as a champion, so the aura's monster damage cap never applies. Darkness Rise's on-hit bonus magic damage (40% AP) applies on every basic attack.
Indestructible (W) is never cast: it produces no damage, only a defensive shield/heal that the damage fight ignores.
Mana is not modeled: every Mordekaiser ability costs 0 per the numbers sheet.
Death's Grasp's cooldown uses the wiki's value (16/14/12/10/8) rather than the mismatched ddragon/bin value (18/16/14/12/10), per the dossier's resolution.

assumed.why: Death's Grasp's 0.5 s pre-damage delay is modeled as measured from the start of the cast (after its own 0.25 s cast time completes) rather than as additional time after the cast time; the dossier does not distinguish the two readings.
